prs.title: Fix: Restrict S3 bucket public access for prod-data-bucket
prs.description:
This PR implements the fix for SOC2 control CC6.1 violation by:
- Removing public access statements from bucket policy
- Enabling 'Block all public access' setting
- Adding AWS Access Analyzer verification

Fixes violation v001
prs.author: security-team

prs.title: Enable encryption at rest for patient-db RDS instance
prs.description:
This PR addresses HIPAA control HP-164.312(a)(2)(iv) by:
- Creating encrypted snapshot of current database
- Restoring to new encrypted RDS instance
- Updating application connection strings
- Implementing automated encryption verification

Fixes violation v002
prs.author: devops-team

prs.title: Implement log masking for credit card data
prs.description:
This PR fixes PCI-DSS control PCI-3.4 violation by:
- Adding regex-based PAN detection to logging library
- Implementing automatic log scrubbing
- Configuring log masking rules
- Adding automated PAN detection tests

Fixes violation v003
prs.author: dev-team

prs.title: Enforce MFA for all administrative accounts
prs.description:
This PR addresses SOC2 control CC7.2 by:
- Creating IAM policy requiring MFA
- Attaching policy to admin group
- Setting up automated compliance monitoring
- Adding MFA setup documentation

Fixes violation v004
prs.author: security-team

prs.title: Restrict SSH access to specific IP ranges
prs.description:
This PR fixes SOC2 control CC6.6 by:
- Removing unrestricted SSH access (0.0.0.0/0)
- Adding specific IP ranges for VPN and office
- Implementing automated security group monitoring
- Documenting approved IP ranges

Fixes violation v006
prs.author: devops-team

prs.title: URGENT: Rotate exposed API keys and implement secrets management
prs.description:
This PR addresses critical SOC2 control CC6.7 violation by:
- Rotating all exposed API keys immediately
- Removing sensitive data from Git history
- Implementing pre-commit hooks for secret detection
- Moving secrets to AWS Secrets Manager
- Adding automated secrets scanning

Fixes violation v009
